# mine_coverage_vectors.txt - hand-derived vectors of the class-0x3000 PLACEMENT as the island function decides it (AnnoWelt 0x1007c790):
# the per-chunk COVERAGE test (0x1007c955-0x1007cb3d, docs/sim/salt-extraction.md section 17) as a predicate SEPARATE from the terrain helper
# (0x10008a80, section 11). Format: tools/placement_ref.py (placement_vectors.txt) plus `anchor x y` (tile byte 3 bit 7) and an optional 8th
# token on `type` (the HIGHMAP table as hex). Island 0 0 24 24, every vertex 0x30 (column 24 and rows 24, 25 are 0, see 12.3); tile chunks are
# the WORLD-aligned 8 x 8 blocks (boundaries at 8 and 16). Mine = 3 wide x 4 tall at rotation 0 (type 1, the salt table). A tile MARKS its chunk
# unless its existing object has flag 0x10 AND the tile's anchor bit is set (a KEPT tile); every chunk the footprint touches must contain a mark.
# Expected: accept <byte> | reject <REASON>; COVERAGE (new) -> engine Reject::TerrainRefused; others as placement_vectors.txt.
#
type 1 3 4 3 3096 0 ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff2020ffffffff1010ffffffff10101010ff100c0c1010ffff0404ffff   # the salt mine 1203: HIGHMAP from Anlagen.dat
type 2 1 1 322 0012 0       # rock, flag 0x10 (coverage type), group 0x141
type 3 1 1 324 0008 0       # object of group 0x141 WITHOUT flag 0x10
type 4 2 2 97 0084 0        # an existing building (not group 0x141): overlap refused
type 5 3 3 3 3096 0 ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff   # a 3x3 mine whose table is all 0xff (terrain never refuses)
